decisions: Keep current Google DEPS ANGLE sources and current EGL backend API
Compile POSIX/Linux-kernel helpers, DMA-buf utilities and native EGL backend on OHOS
Use OHOS native libEGL.so rather than desktop libEGL.so.1
Select native DisplayEGL for OHOS GLES, with desktop OpenGL backend disabled
OHOS remains a distinct Chromium GN platform; ANGLE retains shared Linux-kernel classification and adds ANGLE_PLATFORM_OHOS for native loader selection
